evidence.excerpt: Given a question, PACE drafts a plan specifying what to observe and what will signal completion.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on ProactiveVideoQA and OVO-Bench Forward show that PACE improves over the official protocols by up to 5.9 average PAUC points and 6.2 average accuracy points across proprietary and open-source backbones, yielding state-of-the-art performance.
